source_claims.statement: Coded HTTP/2 client from scratch. Adapted timeout detection. Focused on downgrading desync (H2.CL, H2.TE). Developed tunnelling confirmation via HEAD/Content-Length. Incomplete hotfixes led to further findings.

research_questions.formulation: How do HTTP/2 downgrading and RFC imperfections create exclusive desync and tunnelling opportunities?

layer_b_candidate_principles: HTTP/2 downgrading reintroduces length ambiguity; probe for H2.CL/H2.TE and tunnelling
Incomplete mitigations often leave alternative injection vectors
